Prominent crypto analyst Ali Martinez has identified the immediate important Bitcoin (BTC) price levels using the MVRV extreme deviation pricing bands model. The Bitcoin MVRV extreme deviation bands are statistical bands based on standard deviations of the MVRV ratio from its historical mean. They help identify extreme overvaluation and undervaluation in the Bitcoin market, and thus are useful tools in pointing out resistance and support levels.
